column1: vulnerable§The system is vulnerable at exactly one point, and nine years of upgrades have not touched it.§这套系统恰恰在一个点上**脆弱**，而九年的升级从未碰过它。§vulner（伤口）
waft§The smell of the bakery wafts four streets in the right wind, which is worth more than any advertising.§风向对时面包房的香气能**飘**过四条街，这比任何广告都值钱。§
waiver§The waiver was signed in four seconds and litigated, nine years later, for eighteen months.§这份**弃权书**签字用了四秒，九年后为它打了十八个月官司。§waive（放弃）
wan§Her wan appearance in the photograph is the only sign that the nine-month illness had begun.§照片里她**苍白**的样子，是那场九个月的病已经开始的唯一迹象。§
wary§Investors are wary of the sector after four collapses, and the fifth firm cannot raise anything.§四次崩盘后投资人对这个行业**心存戒备**，第五家公司什么也融不到。§ware（当心，同 aware 意识到）
wasteful§The most wasteful part of the process is the copying: nine copies of a document read by four people.§这个流程最**浪费的**环节是复印——一份四个人读的文件印了九份。§
waver§He wavered for four days over a decision that nine colleagues had already told him was obvious.§他为一个九位同事都说显而易见的决定**犹豫**了四天。§
weary§Nine months of the same argument left her weary of a subject she had once found fascinating.§同一场争论持续九个月，让她对一个曾觉得迷人的题目**心生厌倦**。§
well-wisher§A well-wisher sent four hundred pounds and a note saying only that she had read the article.§一位**祝福者**寄来四百英镑和一张便条，只说她读了那篇文章。§well（好）+ wish（祝愿）
whimsical§The whimsical footnotes are the best thing in a book whose main text takes itself far too seriously.§这些**异想天开的**脚注是全书最好的部分，而正文把自己看得太重。§whim（一时兴致）
whimsicality§The whimsicality of the design hides nine years of extremely careful structural engineering underneath it.§这个设计的**古灵精怪**掩藏着底下九年极其细致的结构工程。§
whimsy§What looks like whimsy is method: every one of the four digressions returns in the final chapter.§看着像**随性怪想**的其实是方法——四段离题话每一段都在末章回来了。§
willful§The willful misreading of a single sentence produced four years of entirely avoidable and very expensive litigation.§对区区一句话的**故意**误读，引出了四年完全可以避免、代价高昂的诉讼。§will（意志）+ ful（充满）
wily§The wily old negotiator conceded nine small points and kept the four that decided the money.§这位**老谋深算的**谈判者让出九个小点，保住了决定钱数的那四个。§wile（诡计）
winnow§They winnowed four hundred applications down to nine in about a week, and interviewed all nine.§他们用约一周把四百份申请**筛选**到九份，并面试了全部九人。§
wistful§Her wistful account of the town she left at nine is the best thing she ever wrote.§她对九岁时离开的那座小镇**充满怅惘的**记述，是她写过的最好的东西。§wist（渴望，与 wish 同源）
withhold§The department withheld four key documents for nine months and then released them without any explanation at all.§这个部门**扣留**了四份关键文件九个月，随后不加任何解释地公布了它们。§with（向后）+ hold（拿住）
worldly§His worldly manner concealed a man who had left the county exactly four times in ninety years.§他**老于世故的**做派掩盖着一个九十年只离开过本郡四次的人。§world（世界）
wrath§The wrath of the town lasted about nine days and changed a policy that four petitions had not.§全镇的**震怒**持续约九天，改变了四次请愿都没能改变的一项政策。§
wrongheaded§The wrongheaded plan was defended for four years by people who had stopped believing in it.§这个**执迷不悟的**方案被一些早已不再相信它的人辩护了四年。§wrong（错）+ headed（头脑的）
